question: Does Kodak's March-2026 first-party VISION Color Intermediate 5242/2242/3242 source contain a reproducible two-domain material-role signature distinct from the frozen VISION3 50D, 250D and 500T camera-negative profiles?

source.title: KODAK VISION Color Intermediate Film 5242 / 2242 / 3242 Technical Information

measurement_context.manufacturer_curve_scope: representative product characteristics, not a standard or a particular roll

required_text_anchors: production of master positives and duplicate negatives from negative originals
For the Master Positive LAD Aim
For the Duplicate Negative LAD Aim
the granularity of the intermediate film is lower than the granularity of any original negative

comparison.normalization: subtract each channel's mean natural-log response on the exact common coordinate grid

allowed_after_pass: retain a non-renderable first-party observed intermediate-material role profile
use the role profile as a measured prior in a separately frozen negative-intermediate-positive or duplicate chain simulator
seek rights-cleared processed intermediate-film observations with process and scanner controls
forbidden: change trace points, axes, channel labels, normalization, threshold or gates after formal scoring
treat intermediate or duplicating material as a camera stock, final print stock or scanner response
infer a digital RGB look, calibrated stock appearance, product profile or output transform
render photographs, train a router or alter the B0/AO6 default from this source-domain result
use explanatory or marketing prose to rescue a failed quantitative signature gate

branch_rule.pass: Retain one non-renderable material_role=colour_intermediate profile and open only a separately frozen physical duplication-chain prior leaf.
branch_rule.fail: Retain the official source facts but close quantitative intermediate-role profile expansion without trace, threshold, normalization or gate rescue.

claim_ceiling: First-party March-2026 manufacturer-raster MTF and diffuse-rms-granularity material-role signature for Kodak 5242/2242/3242 versus three VISION3 camera-negative source profiles; not a particular-roll measurement, final print, scanner response, RGB mapping, calibrated appearance or product operator.
